name: weight-estimator
notes: Per-bird CNN regression. Place a PyTorch nn.Module trained on (crop, weight_g) pairs at model.pt. Typical architecture: MobileNetV3-Small or ResNet18 backbone with a single-output linear head. Inputs are 224x224 RGB crops, ImageNet-normalized. Until model.pt exists, this version reports `available: false` in the dashboard and is unselectable.
